restaurant_name: คลินิกเด็กแก้มยุ้ย (นพ.วีรชาติ)
text: I had a terrible experience. It was my first time there, and the nurse at the front desk gave me a condescending look. I don't know if that's normal for them. I was cut in line even though I arrived earlier, and the person who cut in line hadn't even booked an appointment. But the doctor was very nice.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเด็กแก้มยุ้ย (นพ.วีรชาติ)
text:
The doctor is lovely, the service is good, the assistant is very polite.
And most importantly, the price is friendly.
author_name: บังคอลิด พันธ์ฉลาด

restaurant_name: คลินิกเด็กแก้มยุ้ย (นพ.วีรชาติ)
text: The clinic opened at 1:30 PM, and I had an appointment at 2:00 PM. However, when I arrived at 1:30 PM, the clinic informed me that I would have to wait until 3:00 PM instead. I'm not sure if it was because someone else cut in line before me or because the staff's queue management was inefficient.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเด็กแก้มยุ้ย (นพ.วีรชาติ)
text: Everything is good, but I would like to suggest that the clinic should provide drinking water or sell it to patients while they wait for examinations.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเด็กแก้มยุ้ย (นพ.วีรชาติ)
text: The doctor is excellent. He can tell what's wrong with a child just by looking at their symptoms from the first time. He's also very kind; sometimes he doesn't even charge for the examination. Thank you so much for establishing this children's clinic.
author_name: ทิพวัลย์ ระเบียบ
